name: The Gordon Jump Start Scholarships (Round 1)
summary: Scholarships for students in financial hardship starting a Gordon course via early offer rounds; Gordon scholarships range from $500 to $7,000.
key: The Gordon's Scholarships range in value from $500 to $7000.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident, or bridging, temporary or permanent humanitarian visa holder
Enrolled in a Gordon course of 6 months or more
Under 18s need parent or guardian consent
how: Apply via the Round 1 form on The Gordon scholarships page
catches: Round 1 open 1 September to 31 October; awarded in January
Must apply, accept and be enrolled in your course before 24 November
80% paid at the start, 20% at year end after reporting

source.label: The Gordon: Scholarships and financial assistance

evidence.quote: The Gordon's Scholarships ranging in value from $500 to $7000 can empower you to reach your educational goals,
These scholarships support students applying for early offer rounds that need financial assistance to start their studies.
